Energy Levels Text: You might feel more refreshed and physically stronger. Now is the perfect time for high intensity workouts.
Type of food: Eat foods that will boost your energy levels.
Concentration Levels: At this stage your brain has the lowest level of dynamical complexity, making it be less networked. Due to this, you might feel slower and foggier. Some tips to manage concentrating during this time is to alter diet for brain healthy foods, schedule your time and work strategically so you can still meet your expectations.
Types of Vitamins: Some Vitamins and supplements that you can take throughout your follicular phase consist of Vitamin B to support your energy levels, Omega 3 for heart, brain health, and zinc to help with hormonal balance and contribute to normal fertility.  Before taking any supplements, please contact your doctor.
